item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.38
item.description: A whole playlist (Spotify or YouTube, a YouTube Mix, a channel or artist page) is never downloaded without asking: it waits for your OK. A YouTube search link means its top result only. In a CSV, a link that turns out to be a whole playlist is left out with a note. Pause and Stop work straight away while a list of links is being read. Job cards show the album / playlist / video name instead of the link.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.37
item.description: Notifications now show Bad MxFer's own icon, and clicking one opens the window. New Settings > Importers: add your own importers (write or paste one in, or add a .py file), switch them on and off. Mixed folders, playlists and CSVs are numbered in list order (an album keeps its own track numbers). A CSV link to a track inside a playlist brings just that track.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.36
item.description: A step-by-step progress bar with a heartbeat, and a Stop button for the running import. Sign in to YouTube inside Bad MxFer, so downloads YouTube refuses try again as you. Retry on failed links; 'just this track or the whole playlist?'; image sequences; and a choice for videos at another frame rate (every frame, own rate, or convert).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.35
item.description: Brings Media Composer to the front as soon as an import's media is in, so Avid indexes it straight away (switch in Settings).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.34
item.description: The self test now passes: it checks local videos keep every frame (for conform) instead of expecting them converted to the project rate.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.33
item.description: Shows the Avid project's frame rate and frame size in Settings, and holds an import when the project's frame rate doesn't match Bad MxFer's. Settings changes now always save, even if Bad MxFer restarted while the window was open.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.32
item.description: Clips show your Avid project's name instead of 'Bad MxFer'.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.31
item.description: Long UHD (DNxHR) imports over 2 GB: timelines with the clip save again (Media Composer's 'Range specified for Dup' message).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.30
item.description: Delivering to the drives shows how much has been copied (GB of GB, speed, time left), so a big video copy doesn't look stuck.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.29
item.description: Video imports over 2 GB (long UHD DNxHR files) no longer fail when the bin is made.
